/magazine/1976/02/23/by-destiny-denied-n.head: Background—Scotland, 1823: A man has been arrested for stealing a crust of bread. “I only like the crust,” he explains, and he is identified as the thief who has recently terrorized several chophouses by stealing just the end cut of roast beef.
